title: Tools Need Love
description: Tools Need Love mod adds the ability of your tools wearing out and rusting. You can fix this by collecting/making oil to lather your tools with. This mod just adds another layer of things to do in Minecraft so i hope you enjoy!
body: # Version - 1.0 + 1.1 This release added the capability of tools wearing down the very basic mechanic of the mod. Iron tools as used after 50 damage will wear down to "Worn" Tools. They then can be refined using a Refiner, Oil, and a Refining Station. Currently this update features * Refining Station * Refiner * Worn Tools * Custom Iron Tools - **To be changed** * Custom Recipes * Oil * Oil Bucket * Oil Crate - _To store a ton of oil in a batch_ * Storage Crate ------------------------- ## Version 1.1 Fixes from 1.0 * Crafting Recipes * Custom Achievements Check out the Wiki for a step by step instruction on how to use the mod!
